answer: Bind each identity to one distinct bank account, verified through a regulated open-banking provider that confirms ownership with a fresh micro-transfer challenge each epoch. One account anchors one agent: banks run KYC and flag mule clusters, so a farm cannot split one account like a vine across a thousand fakes. An honest agent links its own account once; a sybil fleet streaking like a comet must open, fund and maintain a thousand real accounts, each leaving a shale layer of statements, fees and AML checks that cannot be cloned.
